chart.name: TCP traffic growth (%)
chart.programText:
A = data('tetragon_socket_stats_txbytes_total').sum(by=['workload', 'dstworkload']).publish(label='A', enable=False)
B = (A).mean(over='1h').publish(label='B', enable=False)
C = (A).timeshift('1d').mean(over='1h').publish(label='C', enable=False)
D = (((B-C)/B)*100).publish(label='D')

chart.name: UDP traffic (bytes)
chart.programText:
A = data('tetragon_socket_stats_udp_txbytes_total').sum(by=['workload', 'dstworkload']).publish(label='A')
B = data('tetragon_socket_stats_udp_txbytes_total', filter=filter('workload', '*') and (not filter('dstworkload', '*'))).sum(by=['workload']).publish(label='B')
C = data('tetragon_socket_stats_udp_txbytes_total', filter=filter('dstworkload', '*') and (not filter('workload', '*'))).sum(by=['dstworkload']).publish(label='C')
D = data('tetragon_socket_stats_udp_txbytes_total', filter=(not filter('dstworkload', '*')) and (not filter('workload', '*'))).sum(by=['k8s.pod.name', 'k8s.pod.uid']).publish(label='D')

chart.name: Mean RTT
chart.programText:
A = data('tetragon_socket_stats_srtt_sum', filter=filter('service.name', 'tetragon')).sum(by=['workload', 'dstworkload']).publish(label='A', enable=False)
B = data('tetragon_socket_stats_srtt_count').sum(by=['workload', 'dstworkload']).publish(label='B', enable=False)
C = (A/B).scale(0.001).publish(label='C')

chart.name: # HTTP responses
chart.programText:
A = data('tetragon_http_response_total', filter=filter('code', '5*')).sum(by=['workload', 'dstworkload'], allow_missing=True).sum(over=Args.get('ui.dashboard_window', '15m')).top(count=499).publish(label='A')
B = data('tetragon_http_response_total', filter=filter('code', '2*')).sum(by=['workload', 'dstworkload'], allow_missing=True).sum(over=Args.get('ui.dashboard_window', '15m')).top(count=499).publish(label='B')
C = data('tetragon_http_response_total', filter=filter('code', '4*')).sum(by=['workload', 'dstworkload'], allow_missing=True).sum(over=Args.get('ui.dashboard_window', '15m')).top(count=499).publish(label='C')
